hooks.name: api-contract-reminder
hooks.description: docs/api.md is the contract; site/ consumers must follow it.

action.prompt: docs/api.md changed. It is the contract between the backend and the site. Check every consumer under site/ (site/world/chat.js, site/dashboard.js) and apps/phantom-phone/hud-web/server.py against the new shapes. Update consumers for added fields, or report a removed or renamed field to the backend owner instead of working around it. Then run tests/test_hud.py and tests/test_world.py.
